Subject: Vendor onboarding: buyer intake and banking / tax details needed

Hi Sarah,

Thanks for choosing to partner with Redwood — excited to get InkWell Supplies set up in our procurement system. To complete vendor onboarding and issue POs, procurement needs a short set of buyer intake fields and banking/tax materials. Could you provide the following?

- Legal entity name (as registered) and physical remit-to address
- W-9 (or W-8 if non-US) — PDF preferred
- Tax ID / EIN
- Preferred billing contact and billing email for invoices
- Remit-to instructions: ACH (bank name, routing, account number) or wire template; if you prefer, we accept secure upload via DocuSign
- A sample invoice or net-terms request (if different from our default net 30)

I've attached a one-page Buyer Intake form (link below) to make this faster: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD-Redwood-Buyer-Intake-Template

If you can return the W-9 and banking info within 3 business days, we can get your vendor record created and provide a PO for the first purchase. If there are any special tax/1099 questions, loop in your tax team and copy us.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

Attachment: Redwood_Buyer_Intake_Form_v1.pdf (link)

Thanks, Sarah — that's helpful. A few quick clarifications so procurement and finance can finish the vendor record: 

- We require full remit-to address to match the W-9 legal name. The address you provided looks good, please ensure it matches line-for-line on the W-9 PDF.
- For ACH: we need either a voided check image or a bank letter (on bank letterhead) that includes the full account number and routing. If you prefer, use DocuSign to send bank account details securely — here's our envelope link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/envelope/ABC12345DEF
- Please complete the buyer intake form (fillable PDF): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD-Redwood-Buyer-Intake-Template — fields include legal entity, tax classification, remit-to, billing contact, and preferred PO email.
- Our default payment terms are Net 30. If you require different terms, include that justification on the intake form and we will route to Finance for approval (cc Monica).

If you can return the completed intake form + voided check or bank letter by EOD Friday (2026-02-06), we'll aim to create your vendor profile and issue an initial PO the following week.

Thanks again —
Jonas
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
